text:
BrightLocal surveyed 1,227 American consumers in 2026. Only 18% of those using AI tools felt ready to contact the business the AI recommended without checking first.

Where do they check? Google. Your reviews, photos and hours.

Keep your Google profile right. That's where the AI crowd ends up.

So you hit the top 3 on Google's map. Good.

The plumber in fourth spot wants your place. He's asking every customer for a review tonight.

The top spot goes to whoever keeps doing the work.

Keep asking for reviews after you get there.

Google's own guide on hiring an SEO says most need four months to a year before you see the benefit.

Plenty of owners hear "four months" and walk away.

Good. Fewer businesses chasing the same spot as you.

Keep going past month three. That's how you end up on the map.
